xtrm-lk07w.description:
## PROBLEM
Specialists currently starts Pi with --no-extensions and reconstructs a hardcoded extension set in two separate spawn paths. The approved design and native Pi probes show that execution.extensions can instead select path/npm/git sources and each enabled source can be forwarded as one explicit -e argument, but the runtime, package artifact, update path, and clean-machine evidence do not yet implement or prove that outcome.

## SUCCESS
A released-candidate Specialists build forwards configured sources identically through PiAgentSession and direct script/serve execution, preserves user overrides across package update, loads Service Knowledge from its standalone package, and passes unit, integration, packed-artifact, local xt build, isolated-install, upgrade, and clean-machine smoke gates. Publication remains a separately approved irreversible action after reviewer PASS.

## SCOPE
/home/dawid/dev/specialists runtime/schema/loader/config/docs/tests/dist/release artifacts; Core's existing local RC pack/install/update smoke surfaces and design document; local isolated HOME/prefix/container validation using packed artifacts.

## NON_GOALS
- No custom extension package resolver or separate extensions.json.
- No Core Pi bundle growth or arbitrary vendoring.
- No npm publish, tag, or force-push without explicit operator confirmation after all pre-release gates.
- No rewrite of Pi or xt interactive ambient extension discovery.

## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: high. Base Specialists work on exact origin/master 79dbecc82789e8cbc02b733c50cd4c7d867043e1; do not inherit the dirty local checkout or unmerged acc7e163. PiAgentSession impact is HIGH (8 direct, 182 depth-3); applyOverrideFields impact is CRITICAL (15 processes), so tests must precede implementation and preserve legacy gitnexus/serena semantics. No new dependency. Log only ordered configured source identifiers; never prompts, credentials, or environment values. Publication is operator-only.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Focused schema/loader/runner/session/script-runner tests pass.
- [ ] Full Specialists lint, test, build, package payload, and attestation gates pass.
- [ ] Both Pi spawn paths produce identical repeated -e ordering and remote-source offline behavior.
- [ ] Packed Specialists artifact installs over v3.21.5 in an isolated prefix and preserves ~/.config/specialists/user.json extension fields.
- [ ] Local packed xt + Specialists artifacts pass existing installed-artifact/update suite and clean-machine/container smoke or an evidenced equivalent.
- [ ] Security auditor and reviewer PASS on cumulative release candidate.
- [ ] Post-publication latest install/update smoke is planned but not executed before explicit approval.

## OUTPUT
Cross-repo completion report with commits/PRs, artifact versions and hashes, exact pass/fail counts, local build/install/update commands, smoke artifact paths, security/reviewer verdicts, publish decision, and any residual platform limitations.

## REFERENCES
Core design commit 21fa05cc, packages/pi-extensions/docs/specialist-extension-injection-design.md. Native probes: xtrm-qejmp. Recent state: Core PR #607 and Specialists PR #271 are latest merged surfaces; Specialists origin/master is 79dbecc8.
xtrm-lk07w.notes:
Specialists-local execution epic: unitAI-jndsb. Mapping: xtrm-lk07w.1→unitAI-jndsb.1 implementation; .2→unitAI-jndsb.2 tests; .3→unitAI-jndsb.3 RC; .5→unitAI-jndsb.4 security; .6→unitAI-jndsb.5 review.
Release gap discovered 2026-09-02: repo skills layout v2 stores Service Knowledge under .xtrm/skills/<pack>/service-knowledge; automatic logical-name resolution and live xt claude/pi/sp run smoke are tracked by xtrm-lk07w.14-.15 and Specialists unitAI-jndsb.11-.13. Publication remains blocked on this matrix.
xtrm-lk07w.title: Ship manifest-configured native Pi extensions end to end

xtrm-lk07w.16.description:
## PROBLEM
Core commit eede9290 is fully validated but exists only on xt/core-pack-skill and has no PR. The always-dev runtime cannot follow main until this code is integrated.

## SUCCESS
A reviewed Core PR lands the exact security-approved production implementation and proof-only tests onto current origin/main without semantic drift. Main is clean and contains the accepted commit content.

## SCOPE
Core branch integration, conflict resolution, existing resolver/test/dist surfaces, PR creation, CI, and merge.

## NON_GOALS
No npm publication. No redesign. Production launch utilities and cli/dist must remain equivalent to accepted eede9290/a9d40d76 constraints.

## CONSTRAINTS
Use an isolated branch/worktree. Preserve security-approved production bytes unless current main requires an explicitly reviewed reconciliation. Run GitNexus impact/detect and all existing gates. Never edit local main directly.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Cumulative diff matches accepted scope.
- [ ] 306-proof suite or current equivalent passes.
- [ ] Typecheck, diff, dist parity, and production equivalence pass.
- [ ] Reviewer/security gates accept the exact PR head.
- [ ] PR merges to origin/main.

## LIBRARIES
N/A — integration of existing code only.

## OUTPUT
PR URL, merged commit, exact test counts, audit verdicts, and any reconciliation delta.
xtrm-lk07w.16.notes: Paused before any integration edit: operator reported ~/.xtrm skill loss caused by validation cleanup. Resume only after global skill recovery is verified.
xtrm-lk07w.16.title: integration: land validated Core resolver on main

## VALIDATION

- [ ] README claims match the integrated head.
- [ ] Reviewer, seconder, and security accept exact PR head.
- [ ] PR merges to origin/master.

## LIBRARIES
N/A — integration of existing code/documentation only.

## OUTPUT
PR URL, merged commit, changed files, exact gates, and residual blockers.

xtrm-lk07w.18.description:
## PROBLEM
This workstation is always-dev: global xt/xtrm/sp/specialists commands must use local default-branch builds rather than wait for npm publication. The current globals are restored package copies and do not contain the accepted candidate bytes.

## SUCCESS
After Core and Specialists integration PRs merge, both repositories are updated to exact merged default-branch heads, built, and linked through the Node v24.15.0 global package/bin locations. Real shell commands resolve to those local main builds and survive a new shell.

## SCOPE
Local main checkout updates, documented project builds, npm/global package links or the existing repository-native link mechanism, bin links, version/hash capture, and rollback metadata.

## NON_GOALS
No npm publish/tag. No links to temporary validation worktrees or feature branches. No modification of unrelated global tools.

## CONSTRAINTS
Wait for both integration merges. Snapshot existing package trees and links before replacement. Keep a rollback command. Link only canonical local main checkouts. Preserve user config and global skills.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] xt/xtrm resolve to the Core local-main build.
- [ ] sp/specialists resolve to the Specialists local-master build.
- [ ] Runtime hashes match freshly built merged heads.
- [ ] New-shell smoke passes.
- [ ] Rollback metadata is complete.

## LIBRARIES
Reuse npm link or the repositories existing local-link workflow; no new dependency.

## OUTPUT
Exact merged heads, build commands, link targets, hashes, new-shell smoke, and rollback instructions.
xtrm-lk07w.18.title: dev-runtime: link global commands to local main builds

xtrm-lk07w.19.description:
## PROBLEM
Link creation alone does not prove that the real operator commands execute the merged main code across repositories.

## SUCCESS
A post-link smoke runs real xt Pi/Claude role binding and Specialists pre-script execution from the main-linked commands, confirms project-pack machinery and extension forwarding, preserves repository/user state, and leaves zero temporary residue.

## SCOPE
Installed command resolution, main-head hashes, one bounded consumer smoke, configuration preservation, logs, restoration fallback, and cleanup inventory.

## NON_GOALS
No publication. No full reconciliation workflow. No waiver of security/runtime blockers.

## CONSTRAINTS
Use audit-only prompts and bounded sessions. Capture command paths and package realpaths. Do not mutate production consumer knowledge. Stop and roll back links on a main-build mismatch.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Command/package realpaths point to local default-branch checkouts.
- [ ] Project-pack resolution and repo-local machinery execute through real commands.
- [ ] Extension forwarding remains active.
- [ ] Consumer and global config hashes remain unchanged.
- [ ] Cleanup inventory is zero.
- [ ] Reviewer accepts the main-linked runtime receipt.

## LIBRARIES
N/A — existing commands and smoke harnesses.

## OUTPUT
Main-linked runtime receipt with exact paths, heads, hashes, smoke results, cleanup, and reviewer verdict.
xtrm-lk07w.19.title: test-runner: verify always-dev main-linked runtime end to end

xtrm-lk07w.7.description:
## PROBLEM
Local readiness does not make the feature available to other machines. Publication is irreversible and must occur only after evidence and explicit operator approval.

## SUCCESS
After explicit approval, the reviewed Specialists version is published with the intended dist-tag, registry metadata is verified, a fresh isolated install and v3.21.5→latest update pass, Core's version checker reports the new latest, and the post-release smoke remains green.

## SCOPE
npm publication of @jaggerxtrm/specialists only, tag/release metadata required by repository policy, post-publish isolated install/update checks, and final epic closure.

## NON_GOALS
- No xtrm-tools or service-knowledge package publication unless a separate reviewed change requires it.
- No publication before operator approval.

## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: critical. Human decision required. Verify npm identity/auth/2FA/trusted publishing immediately before action. Never force-push or republish an existing version. On any preflight mismatch, stop without side effects.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Reviewer PASS and all prior children closed.
- [ ] Operator explicitly approves npm publish.
- [ ] npm view reports expected version, dist-tag, integrity, and package metadata.
- [ ] Fresh isolated latest install exercises native extension forwarding.
- [ ] Upgrade from 3.21.5 to latest preserves user config and passes sp doctor/list/validate.
- [ ] Post-release Core smoke/version check passes.

## OUTPUT
Publish decision, command and registry result, package integrity, post-release smoke artifacts, or exact no-publish blocker.
xtrm-lk07w.7.title: Publish Specialists release and verify latest update
